text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is finally here...! 
I can't wait to see Spe and Sky face off!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it'll be Special Week? She's 
gotten so much stronger again lately!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Well, Spe is the obvious pick, but given 
the distance, Sky is bound to be a factor 
as well. Above all else—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
If it's her, she'll pull something off. I 
just can't shake that feeling!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. Spe-chan looks like she's got 
herself in top shape after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I want to eliminate as many doubts as 
possible. If taking deep breaths increases 
my win rate, I'll do it as much as it 
takes."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, naturally that alone won't cut it, 
so... I really have to do my best, huh.
choice_data_list: I'm watching you give it your all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, do you really have to put it like 
that~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's a tiny bit embarrassing, so please 
squint while you look at me~
